thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To find all unique combinations that sum up to a target value, we can use a backtracking approach. Starting from each candidate element, we explore all possible combinations by adding the element to the current combination and recursively searching for the remaining sum. If the sum becomes equal to the target, we add the current combination to the result. This process is repeated for each candidate element.
